clue.text: The union's got a nice settlement after all

indicators.note: after places the reworked letters behind the word all in the answer

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: a settlement is an arrangement reached, so the letters of a nice are arranged anew

explanation.surface: A union's members finally agreed a pleasing deal once everything was said and done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after all' reads as the stock phrase meaning 'in the end', but 'after' is the positioning signal and 'settlement' rearranges A NICE (giving IANCE).
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance is a joining together of parties, a pact or federation.

clue.text: Warns assembly about English response

indicators.note: about means going round, so the shuffled letters surround the abbreviation
assembly means putting parts together in a new order, so the letters of Warns are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone cautions a gathering about how to reply in English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' turns WARNS into ANSWR, and 'about' wraps those letters round E.
explanation.definitionFit: A reply or retort to a question is a response.

clue.text: Bound to be beaten!

explanation.surface: A pupil is certain to get a thrashing.
explanation.definitionFit: Lashed means tied fast with rope, and also whipped or flogged.

clue.text: Panics as about fifty prepare to do battle

indicators.note: about means placed round, so the word as encloses the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to arm is to equip oneself with weapons for a fight

explanation.surface: Fear spreads as fifty soldiers get ready to fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is not a link here: it supplies the outer letters A...S around L and ARM.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarms are sudden frights, so panics in the noun sense.

clue.text: Against players getting in without authority

parts.note: contra is Latin-derived for against, as in pros and contras
a band is a group of musicians playing together

explanation.surface: Musicians who are opposed to the rules sneak in unauthorised.
explanation.definitionFit: Contraband goods are smuggled or prohibited, brought in illegally.

clue.text: Quick game included in the work-out

indicators.note: included in means placed inside, so the word for game goes within the abbreviation

parts.note: PT stands for physical training, exercise sessions
a romp is a lively game or frolic

explanation.surface: A fast game is part of the gym session.
explanation.walkthrough: PT, physical training, is the school exercise lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: Prompt as an adjective means punctual, done without delay.

clue.text: Carpeting for a number in existing situation

indicators.note: in means placed within, so these pieces sit inside the other word

parts.note: something real exists in the actual situation rather than in imagination
pro means in favour of, for
V is the Roman numeral five, a number

explanation.surface: A carpet-fitter quotes for a certain number in the current circumstances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpeting' is a dressing-down, as in being 'carpeted' by the boss, not floor covering.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpeting is an informal word for a severe telling-off or rebuke.

clue.text: Chinese bureaucrat causing harm outside and in

indicators.note: outside means placed around, so the word for harm wraps the next word

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or damage
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Chinese official does damage both externally and internally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside and in' reads as a pair of opposites, but 'outside' is the container signal and 'and' is a word of the answer, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandarin was a senior official in imperial China's civil service.

clue.text: Exchanging about a quarter would appear pressing

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for exchanging goes round the other letters

parts.note: trading means swapping or exchanging goods
E for east is one quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: Swapping roughly a quarter of the stock seems urgent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about a quarter' looks like an estimate but gives the pieces E and A inside TRADING.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading is stepping down on something, crushing grapes underfoot for example.

clue.text: Carries colours all round America

indicators.note: all round means enclosing, so the word for colours surrounds the abbreviation

parts.note: stains are dyes or tints that colour wood or fabric
US stands for United States, America

explanation.surface: Someone bears dyes all over the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain something is to bear its weight or support it.

clue.text: An inhabitant of water that's cleaner

explanation.surface: A creature of the sea turns out to be a cleaning aid.
explanation.definitionFit: A sponge is a simple sea animal, and its dried skeleton or a synthetic copy is used for washing.

clue.text: Nevertheless it's for always!

parts.note: split the first word as never-less: something that is never less is always more, which gives a word for for ever

explanation.surface: However, this is permanent.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Nevertheless' as 'never less'; the opposite way of saying it is 'ever more', meaning always.
explanation.definitionFit: Evermore means always, for all time to come.

clue.text: Timid fellow taking care of a minor

parts.note: c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of
a ward is a child under a guardian's protection

explanation.surface: A nervous man is looking after a child.
explanation.definitionFit: A coward is a person lacking courage, easily frightened.

clue.text: This will make for a good atmosphere to travel in maybe

definitions.text: This will make for a good atmosphere

indicators.note: maybe signals the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Travelling inside this would make the air pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges the ten letters of TO TRAVEL IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A ventilator is a fan or opening that keeps air fresh in a room.

clue.text: Disclaimer — there's no beating a developer!

indicators.note: a developer reshapes things, so the letters of no beating a are reworked

explanation.surface: A property developer issues a statement that nobody will be beaten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developer' looks like the subject; it is the signal to rearrange NO BEATING A.
explanation.definitionFit: Abnegation is renunciation or denial, giving up a claim.

clue.text: Value a really quiet lift

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
to raise is to lift up

explanation.surface: A surveyor gives a valuation of a very silent elevator.
explanation.definitionFit: To appraise is to assess or estimate the worth of something.

clue.text: Sound made by bad-tempered snake?

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
irate means angry

explanation.surface: A noise comes from an angry serpent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' is a noun: an aspirate is a breathy h sound.
explanation.definitionFit: In phonetics an aspirate is the breath sound of h.

clue.text: Turn in goal and even nearly score

indicators.note: turn means turn round, so the word in is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
the net is the goal in football
e'en is the poetic contraction of even

explanation.surface: A footballer swivels in the goalmouth and nearly scores to level the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'score' is twenty, so 'nearly score' is one short of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is twenty, so one less than that number is just under it.

clue.text: Eager to hand one over with a note

parts.note: to pass something is to hand it on
I is the Roman numeral one
on means upon, placed over something
te is the seventh note in sol-fa

explanation.surface: Someone is keen to hand over a single musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: Passionate means ardent or intensely enthusiastic.

clue.text: French place for a bit of photography ere spring comes

indicators.note: a bit of means only a portion of the words is taken

explanation.surface: A French resort gets photographed before spring arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'photograPHY ERE Spring'. Hyeres is a resort on the French Riviera.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyeres is a town on the Mediterranean coast of Provence.

clue.text: Spread a lie is what co-ordinators do!

indicators.note: spread means scattered about, so the letters of a lie is are rearranged

explanation.surface: Spreading falsehoods is what organisers get up to.
explanation.definitionFit: To liaise is to act as a link between groups, keeping them in contact.

clue.text: Land in flames

explanation.surface: Touch down while burning.
explanation.definitionFit: Alight means to come down and settle, and also on fire.

clue.text: Sally will accept points put forward

indicators.note: accept means take in, so the word for sally holds the other letters

parts.note: a sally is a sudden attack or raid
S and E are compass points, south and east

explanation.surface: A woman called Sally will agree to the arguments presented.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a name; it is a sortie, RAID.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise an idea is to bring it up or propose it.

clue.text: Publicity for William Shakespeare?

parts.note: the bard's first name shortened is Bill, and he wrote plays, so a theatre poster is pictured as a nickname for him

explanation.surface: Advertising aimed at the Bard.
explanation.walkthrough: William is Bill, and Shakespeare is the play-man: a theatre poster becomes the playwright's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: A playbill is a poster advertising a theatre production.

clue.text: A woman is able to adapt

indicators.note: to adapt is to alter, so the letters of is able are rearranged

explanation.surface: A female who can adjust.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabel is a girl's name, a variant of Elizabeth.

clue.text: Making a beginning can be disturbing

explanation.surface: Getting under way may prove upsetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Starting means setting out, and also flushing or rousing game from cover.

clue.text: Cast off

parts.note: read it as the actors leaving the stage, a stage direction, rather than knitting or discarding

explanation.definitionFit: Exeunt is the Latin stage direction meaning they go out.

clue.text: Most foolish head swallowing dope

indicators.note: swallowing means taking in, so the word for head encloses the other

parts.note: a crest is the top or head of a hill
an ass is a fool, a dope

explanation.surface: The chief swallows drugs, which is the height of stupidity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' suggests drugs but means a fool, ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Crassest is the superlative of crass, meaning grossly stupid.
